summary: Comprehensive testing of Next.js portfolio (single-app on :3000) covering all requested backend routes (reviews CRUD + reactions, messages CRUD, visits tracking + aggregations, settings persistence) and all requested frontend flows (admin login, blog CRUD via admin, public /blogs list + detail render, like/dislike with vote-switch + reload persistence, contact form -> admin messages, admin visits/analysis real counts, settings navbar/feature/adsense persistence, Skills removed from Manage, blog delete cascading to public, regression on home/about/projects/privacy). All 15 pytest cases pass and all 25+ Playwright UI assertions pass. One non-blocking React warning found (see code review).
action_items: MINOR (non-blocking): Fix React warning `Cannot update a component (InnerShell) while rendering a different component (AdminSettingsPage)` observed on /admin/settings. Likely a setState call happening during render inside AdminSettingsPage (or a hook like useSiteSettings) that updates PublicShell/InnerShell context. Wrap the offending state update in useEffect or defer via setTimeout/queueMicrotask. Reproduction: navigate to http://localhost:3000/admin/settings after login; warning appears in browser console. Functionally the page works and settings persist.

MINOR (code review): /app/app/lib/db.js has `DB_NAME = process.env.DB_NAME || 'portfolio'` — default value violates the 'omit defaults' guideline in the environment charter. .env.local sets DB_NAME=portfolio_db so this is currently harmless, but the fallback should be removed to fail fast if the env is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: Reaction endpoint (/api/reviews/[id]/reaction) correctly clamps negatives via a follow-up updateOne to 0. Good.
Reviews create endpoint validates required fields (type/title/description) and returns 400. Good.
Settings PUT merges with defaults so a partial PUT never wipes navbar keys. Good.
Visits aggregation uses efficient distinct + $group; response shape matches admin UI needs.
Client-side dedup for like/dislike is done via localStorage in ReactionBar — same visitor across browsers can inflate counts; acceptable per PRD but worth noting.
React setState-in-render warning on /admin/settings page (see action_items).
DB_NAME default 'portfolio' in /app/app/lib/db.js should be removed (env charter).
seed_data_creation: None left behind. Test blog was created, edited, then deleted through admin UI. Test contact message was deleted via API. Settings toggled and restored. Visits test data left in DB (visitorId prefixed TEST_visitor_*) but this is analytics data and does not affect UX; 5 pre-existing visits observed on admin dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is standalone Next.js on :3000 (not FastAPI+React). Use http://localhost:3000 directly. Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and passes 15/15 in ~3s. All data-testids exist as documented in review request. Admin login is simple localStorage flow (admin/admin -> adminToken=admin-token-123). Reviews collection starts empty by design — do not seed. Blog cards on public /blogs are the only cards from reviews collection filtered by type='blog'. Reaction dedup is client-side (localStorage) so a fresh browser context can re-vote; server accepts any action+previous combo and clamps negatives to 0. Chatbot widget is static UI (no AI). Roles page is static. There is a benign React setState-in-render warning on /admin/settings — non-blocking. Cleanup helper: DELETE /api/messages/{id}, DELETE /api/reviews/{id}.
